labels.batchHint: Print labels for several layers at once

stockCount.hint: Count the shelves with the scanner and compare against the system
stockCount.title: Stocktake
stockCount.intro: Scan the shelves. Counting changes nothing — you see the result first.
stockCount.scopePartialHint: Layers you do not scan are left alone.
stockCount.scopeFullWarn: Careful: every layer you do not scan counts as gone.
stockCount.confirmCancel: Throw this count away? Nothing will be saved.
stockCount.surplusNote: Extra stock is not added to the books: its cost is unknown. Usually this means a wrong label or a miscount.
stockCount.apply: Correct the books (write off what is missing)
stockCount.applyNotYours: Only the Founder may write stock off.
stockCount.confirmApply: Write off {{units}} units ({{amount}})? This cannot be undone.

layerPrice.hint: Change what this layer sells for
layerPrice.title: Selling price — layer #{{layer}}
layerPrice.clearHint: Leave empty to fall back to where it read before.
layerPrice.note: This only sets what is displayed and pre-filled on the sale form. The seller still strikes the real price at the counter. The balance sheet and profit do not change.
